data.name: Ula vs. Nightmare
data.detailed_description: Ula vs. Nightmare is a narrative-driven 3rd-person, adventure, creepy-cute platform game in which you play as a little fabric doll with a pair of vintage scissors, running through a little girl's nightmare to save her from the coma she's trapped in. Players battle through a surreal nightmare, fighting dark entities known as umbramites, solve puzzles to collect memories, and defeat the different stages of trauma that inflict terror upon the little girl's mind. Fear, an adversarial narrator, narrates 15 chapters that alternate with every choice the player makes. She can sneak her way past enemies or fight through them. Multiple endings add replay value for gamers looking to get a full 8-hour experience.

data.short_description: Ula vs Nightmare is an eerie platform adventure in a reality-shifting imaginary realm. Explore childhood fears, fight dark entities, solve cryptic puzzles, save fragmented memories, and sneak past dangers, all while being guided by an adversarial narrator to save a little girl from her coma.
